definitions.explanation: A facility equipped for observing celestial objects and astronomical phenomena.

examples.japanese: {天文台|てんもんだい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: To observe stars at the observatory.

notes:
A facility equipped with telescopes and instruments for observing celestial bodies and phenomena.

FORMS:
{天文|てんもん} (astronomy) + {台|だい} (platform, station).

- ⟦{国立|こくりつ}→国立：04153_kokuritsu⟧{天文台|てんもんだい}: national astronomical observatory

- {天文台|てんもんだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧: to visit an observatory
